scientific_integrity: The n=1 exact CDF is credited to the original work and used solely as a consistency check. Numeric tests are finite corroboration, not analytical proof. Historical priority is qualified, including an uninspected 2023 thesis.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer sample size n>=2, fully specified continuous null, t tending to infinity; no uniform growing-n rate, no finite-tail error bound, no composite-null parameter estimation, no power claim. General constant is a finite explicit Dirichlet integral rather than an elementary expression.
title: Two-corner extreme-tail law for the recursive product of spacings
